records.text: Owens said she did not find Cabot Phillips on Morning Wire from September 4 through September 10, while noting that he was not a daily host
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And I checked and he's missing from the morning wire. He doesn't do it daily, but he does it enough times that I noticed that he is missing from September 4th to the September 10th on that show.

verification.notes: The September 10, 2025 Morning Wire episode includes Cabot Phillips as a speaker. Because the claim says he was missing from the show through September 10, that dated counterexample is sufficient to refute it. Owens did caveat that Phillips was not a daily host, but the date-bounded absence claim is still false.

sources.relevance: The September 10 episode summary identifies Cabot Phillips speaking at 07:13, directly contradicting the claim that he was absent through September 10.

records.text: Mitch Snow said he saw Erika Kirk leave the Candlewood Suites hotel at Fort Huachuca on September 8 with someone resembling Cabot Phillips.
records.speaker: Mitch Snow

appearances.snippet: Erika Kirk on the 8th leaving the Candlewood Suites hotel on the base on Fort Huachuca. She was with somebody who looked similar to Cabot Phillips.

verification.notes: Public searches surfaced repetitions of Mitch Snow's account and competing denials, but no independent hotel record, image, or authenticated witness evidence establishes whom he saw.

records.text: Tyler Bowyer, Erika Kirk, and Cabot Phillips attended and graduated from Liberty University, while Michael McCoy was accepted but joined Turning Point USA instead.

appearances.snippet: Tyler Bowyer attended and he graduated Erika Kirk attended and she graduated Cabot Phillips attended and he graduated Mikey McCoy was accepted into Liberty University but then he chose not to attend because he got the job at Turning Point USA instead

verification.notes: Official Liberty sources confirm Erika Kirk and Cabot Phillips as alumni and Michael McCoy’s early TPUSA employment. Public sources reviewed did not establish Tyler Bowyer’s graduation or McCoy’s claimed acceptance/nonattendance, so the composite is only partly verified.

records.text: Mitch Snow has consistently said that on September 8 he saw Erika Kirk leaving a Fort Huachuca hotel with someone resembling Cabot Phillips.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And I want to be clear, he also hasn't moved his story since, ... not one inch. He was certain that he saw Erika Kirk on the evening of the 8th at Fort Huachuca leaving a hotel with a Cabot Phillips lookalike.

verification.notes: This is a claim about what Mitch Snow has consistently said, not proof that the sighting occurred. A later interview transcript records Snow again identifying the people he says he saw at the Fort Huachuca hotel as Erika Kirk and a man he later associated with Cabot Phillips. Phillips has publicly denied being there and reportedly offered Nashville-location evidence, so the underlying sighting remains unverified.

records.text: At the gun-patent dinner, Erika Kirk joined the business discussion and Lori Frantzve said Erika was dating a politically connected man, understood in retrospect to be Cabot Phillips.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep xi8SYJTUXPM)

appearances.snippet: And I'm told that during this discussion, Erika then drops the fact that she has—and her mother says, 'Oh, well, she's—it's not known yet, but she's just now dating a guy who' ... has some very big political connections.' They're just a couple of months into dating, because that sweetens the deal a little bit. 'Oh, you got this beautiful girl,' and now you realize this girl has access to someone who is a player, right? And the person, in retrospect, thought that she was talking about Charlie Kirk, but she actually wasn't. At this time, according to our timeline, Erika was dating Cabot Phillips.

verification.notes: Transcript context attributes the dinner conversation and dating reference to an anonymous source. No contemporaneous record or on-record participant account was found to verify Erika Kirk attended or that Lori Frantzve made the described statement.

records.text: Mitch tentatively identified Cabot Phillips from a photo, but Owens cautioned that it could be a lookalike and that the identification was unreliable
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Anyways, I sent him the picture of Cabot Phillips and he says, yes, that's the person I remember being at the base. ... Maybe again, this could be a lookalike. ... I messaged Cabot Phillips twice today actually and asked him if he wanted to have an off record conversation because we can't just like take that to the bank. ... And I can't trust Mitch's vision on this, but it at least is compelling.

verification.notes: The transcript supports that Mitch made the photo identification and, crucially, that Owens immediately said it could be a lookalike, could not be taken to the bank, and that she could not trust his vision. No independent image-identification evidence or corroborated base record was found. The migrated statement and snippet now preserve those material caveats.

appearances.snippet: And then I saw a picture in somebody's TikTok of Cabot Phillips. ... There's a lot of social media activity between her and his family. ... I don't know about any of this at all, but it is interesting that they had a relationship

verification.notes: Searches found rumor-based articles and social-media discussion but no direct confirmation from either person or reliable primary documentation of a dating relationship. The transcript itself presents internet material and acknowledges uncertainty. The statement is therefore retained as Owens allegation rather than a confirmed relationship.
